verdict.rationale: Amplitude exposes broad APIs (HTTP V2 ingestion, Dashboard REST, Cohorts, Experiment/Flag APIs, OpenAPI spec) covering core analytics and experimentation, letting users replicate many UI actions programmatically. However, several flagship UI-only features—session replay, visual A/B test editor, heatmaps, in-product surveys/guides, and the AI 'ask in plain language' chat—have no documented API equivalent, so full UI-API parity isn't demonstrated.
